reference: EGP A1 determiners: a/an chosen by first sound of singular countable noun; Cambridge A1 Movers / Pre A1 style gap-fill.
matching: Forms A/B/C use the same 9 item types in the same order (3 gap-fill, 1 choice, 2 error-correction, 2 free production, 1 transfer). Item n tests the same sub-rule in every form: 1 an + vowel-sound adjective (old); 2 an + silent h (hour); 3 a + 'yu' sound (u-word); 4 an + vowel noun (choice); 5 article omission before a job noun; 6 a used before vowel; 7-8 open sentence with a/an; 9 add a/an to a 4-word list (2 an, 2 a). Prompts within ±2 words; all nouns A1 high-frequency (EVP A1), 'uniform/university/useful' A2 at most.
